newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-,6-,9-mo T-bill yields fall, 12-mo same.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-,6-,9-mo T-bill yields fall, 12-mo same.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury edged down to 51.10 percent from 55.99 percent at the last sale on November 26, a central bank statement said on Monday.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 7.34 million UAH 29.389 million UAH
Actual amount raised 6.51 million UAH 25.789 million UAH
The central bank sold 73,414 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 19,373 were competitive and 54,041 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for December 10.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills slipped to 59.80 percent from 59.90 percent at the last sale on November 28, a central bank statement said.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 35.07 million UAH 42.29 million UAH
Actual amount raised 27.02 million UAH 32.56 million UAH
The central bank sold 350,735 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 278,756 were competitive and 71,979 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for December 10.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills slipped to 58.51 percent from 58.54 percent at the last sale on November 28, a central bank statement said.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Actual amount raised 216,330 UAH 61.452 million UAH
The central bank sold 3,110 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 50 were competitive and 3,060 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for December 10.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills was unchanged at 61.20 percent, the same as at the last sale on November 28, a central bank statement said.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 4,932 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 4,900 were competitive and 32 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for December 10.
